posts.name: Aditya Yadav
posts.cooked: we have to learn all the editors for OPPE ?

posts.name: Sarang Balakrishnan
posts.cooked: No, you don’t need to learn all the editors. You can simply choose any one. It’s entirely based on personal preference.

posts.name: Satyanarayana-POD
posts.cooked: Hi, you should be mostly familiar with the vi/vim editor. That’s the standard editor in Linux.

posts.name: Aditya Yadav
posts.cooked: vim, vi is two different editor so we should learn both

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: They are both similar, but vim has more features than vi. Thus vi is the recommended one.

posts.name: Aditya Yadav
posts.cooked: so technically we can go for oppe with VI/VIM editor

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Or even nano or emacs. As Sarang mentioned, it’s a choice of personal preference. But we’d recommend to go ahead with VIM.
